items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Trummy Young only in the context of other musicians (Curtis, Tommy, John, Leo Williams) having played with him or being with his band. The interviewee does not state they personally played with, met, or collaborated with Trummy Young.

ctx.x: So he went with Trummy Young.
Curtis, Tommy and John went with Trummy.
